pdpa.title: Personal Data Protection Consent Notice (PDPA)
pdpa.subtitle: Faculty of Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chulalongkorn University — CU-PFIS
pdpa.firstLoginNotice: Please review and accept our Personal Data Protection Policy before using CU-PFIS for the first time (Requirement A18).
pdpa.sec1Body: CU-PFIS stores faculty profile records (bilingual names, academic positions, education, email, phone, publications, training history), student/graduate records synced from CUPPEP, and training reimbursement details for authorized personnel only.
pdpa.sec2Body: Data is used exclusively for academic administration, Faculty & Student record management, fiscal-year training budget management, pharmacy license tracking, graduate employment verification, employer evaluations, senior project archiving, and 10-year annual reporting.
pdpa.sec3Body: Sensitive fields such as faculty bank account numbers and employer evaluations are strictly restricted to authorized department/finance staff, excluded from general reports/exports, and never written to plaintext application logs.
pdpa.sec4Body: You have the right to access, verify, and request correction of your personal data. Please contact the Academic Affairs Office, Faculty of Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chulalongkorn University.
pdpa.checkboxText: I have read, understood, and consent to the collection, use, and processing of my personal data by CU-PFIS for the purposes stated above.
pdpa.declineNote: Your acceptance timestamp, user account, and policy version will be persistently recorded.
pdpa.alreadyAccepted: You have already accepted this PDPA policy on
